job: Ask for the one next step near the end of a page: a band, an inset panel, or a title beside a one-field form.
purpose: band: a full-width ground with a title and actions, the home of the texture and inverse grounds. card: an inset panel inside the container. split: a title at the start and, at the end, actions or a one-field email form built from fd-field with its invalid, busy and sent states.
useWhen: The end of a landing page, before the footer.
A newsletter or waitlist sign-up (split with a form).

avoidWhen.when: A message that needs attention in the app.

states.name: invalid
states.how: aria-invalid="true" on the input and an fd-field-error

states.name: sent
states.how: the field replaced by .fd-site-cta-done with role="status"

variants.useWhen: A closing band on its own ground.
An inset panel on a page that is already busy with grounds.
A title and a form or actions side by side.
